content: He who sees the Supreme Lord dwelling equally in all beings, the imperishable in things that perish, he truly sees.
author: Swami Vivekananda
explanation:
In this profound teaching from Jnana Yoga, Swami Vivekananda cuts through superficial illusion to reveal a foundational truth of human character. When we operate from fear, distraction, or narrow self-interest, our potential remains fragmented and fragile. By anchoring attention in vision, we awaken an unshakeable clarity that transforms how we navigate hardship and purpose.

True wisdom is never an abstract academic debate; it is an active discipline forged in the quiet arena of daily choices. When your internal conviction matches your outward conduct, the entire trajectory of your life shifts toward lasting strength and peace.
practicalInsight: Take deliberate ownership of your vision today. Strip away trivial distractions and act with steady, uncompromising integrity.
reflectionPrompt: How can you apply greater vision to the primary challenge facing your life right now?
